name: Funding-carry harvest, calm-DVOL gated — collect positive carry only when implied vol is low
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from funding-carry-long-spot [gated by realized vol + a trend filter] and funding-gated-momentum [funding ceiling, no carry accrual]; this conditions the CARRY harvest on crypto-native IMPLIED vol via DVOL, a gauge no funding spec uses): the funding carry trade — hold spot, accrue positive funding via the basis — earns a steady premium but blows up in regimes where the carry premium is actually compensation for tail risk (a frothy, high-IV market about to mean-revert violently, the funding-spike-before-crash pattern). Realized vol (the existing carry spec's gate) is BACKWARD-looking; DVOL is the options market's FORWARD-looking 30d implied vol — a leading read on whether the carry is safe or is a coiled spring. So harvest positive funding ONLY when DVOL is low (the market is not pricing a coming vol event): low DVOL means the positive carry is a genuine risk premium, not crash compensation. The funding_feature accrues the realized funding to the open long each bar. Entry: funding_rate above a fitted positive floor (real carry) AND dvol below a fitted calm ceiling (implied vol is low — carry is safe) AND price in a non-broken trend. Exit: funding_rate flips negative (carry gone) OR dvol crosses up into stress (the calm regime broke — exit before the spring uncoils); plus stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if the existing realized-vol-gated carry (funding-carry-long-spot) does as well, DVOL adds no forward-looking information and this is that spec re-skinned. Disconfirmer 2: if unconditional positive-funding carry matches the deflated Sharpe, the DVOL gate adds nothing. Disconfirmer 3 (cost): the carry minus ~20bps round-trip (entered/exited per signal) must be net positive — a carry that only pays gross is fee-dead. Disconfirmer 4 (data depth): only ~148 DVOL points — low-confidence, paper-only until it deepens. tier0 funding + tier0 crypto-native vol features.
catalyst: positive perp carry in a low-implied-vol regime — a genuine carry premium, not crash compensation
